lines.text: I never would have agreed to training you, but M insisted.
Well, you’ll have to take it up with her. All I know is I found a secret tape on a beach and now I’m here.

Found a tape. Ha. Just another Dookie who thinks he can Kerplunk his way into the spy world with a secret tape. Well here’s a 21st Century Breakdown for you: we’re not playing Revolution Radio anymore...
A word of Warning, don’t go strutting around like an American Idiot thinking you’re any of our Saviours: there’s a fine line between 39/Smooth and Nimrod.
Copy that. Don’t worry about me, believe it or not I'm more than just a compilation of Shenanigans.
